intro: Guinea has mangrove coasts, the Fouta Djallon highlands, savanna and forested mountains.

chapters.title: Four regions
text: Lower Guinea is the coast; Middle Guinea the Fouta Djallon plateau with waterfalls; Upper Guinea savanna along the Niger; and Forest Guinea in the south-east, with Mount Nimba.

chapters.title: Water tower
text: The Niger, Senegal and Gambia rivers all rise in Guinea.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Guinea's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
